text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos hasn't been feeling well lately.
She said she wanted to visit a power spot shrine, so I accompanied her, but...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Inhaaaale... Exhaaaaale!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I feel like it's working!
As expected of a power spot!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...It works... right? Right?
It was trending on social media, too... ......"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Jeez! Saying that just proves you're still brooding over it!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Uuu! No no no no no~!
This isn't like me at all~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I know! If it's come to this—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Looking at the current flow of qi, green is good!
Take a slow, deep breath while looking at the trees—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hannyaka~...!
Funnyaka~...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: —It came up! Vivlos-san's lucky spot is in front of the station!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Looking at the greenery on the wall...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: *inhale*... *sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ......and from there――

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hannyaka~ funnyaka~~!
Honnyaka~ bunchaka~~!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, feeling good...!
The more I do it, the better it feels...!
choice_data_list: (Isn't that taking the influence a bit too far...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite my concerns,
I decided to keep watching over them for now.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: All right! Next is—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Wait, no way...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yay!! That limited-edition cosmetic that was sold out
got back in stock because of a cancellation!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
This must be because of all the prayers and stuff we did!
It worked! That's amazing!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Now I'll be totally fine♪
Peace♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was worried it was too simplistic...
but from that day on, Vivlos began to regain her top form.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Today was the release day for those cosmetics!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
They're sold out... you say...?
...Usually, I would... never forget...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ..................Can't do it anymore. *Flop*.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she tried grasping at every straw she could,
Vivlos remained out of sorts after that...
